roles.name: Lab Founder
roles.description: The founder and owner of AxolotlBucketLabs.

roles.name: Lab Associate
roles.description: A trusted co-founder or administrator who helps manage the organization, its projects, and its members.
requirements: Willingness to help manage organization responsibilities.

roles.name: Lab Fellow
roles.description: An honorary recognition role for a person who has earned broad respect from the Lab Founder, Lab Associates, Lab Members, and Lab Maintainers.
requirements: Broad recognition from the organization or its community.
No role-specific administrative or project responsibility.

roles.name: Lab Member
roles.description: A trusted official member of the GitHub organization. Repository access is granted separately according to project needs and established permissions.
requirements: Normally, at least two meaningful merged pull requests to AxolotlBucketLabs projects.
Contributions that provide real value and are not trivial changes made only to obtain the role.
Trustworthy communication and a willingness to participate over time.
Responsible review and testing of AI-assisted work.
exceptions: An approved project maintainer or a person with substantial ongoing contributions that are not represented by pull requests may be considered after manual review.
An exception does not guarantee approval and requires a specific reason related to the person's contribution or responsibility.

roles.name: Lab Maintainer
roles.description: A person responsible for the ongoing development, maintenance, and quality of at least one organization project.
requirements: A suitable organization project or an approved project proposal.
Relevant technical experience or demonstrated project work.
Willingness to maintain the project over time.
An appropriate license for any proposed fork.

roles.name: Lab Collaborator
roles.description: A trusted external collaborator who actively contributes to specific organization projects and may receive repository-level access.
requirements: A demonstrated need for repository-level access.

roles.name: Lab Contributor
roles.description: A community member who has made a meaningful contribution to at least one organization project.
requirements: At least one meaningful merged pull request or equivalent project contribution.
A contribution that provides real value to the project.
No trivial change made only to obtain a role.
